records.failureSummary: Delivered a complete, contract-correct container image definition (node:22-alpine; corepack + "pnpm install --frozen-lockfile"; COPY app; ENV DATA_DIR=/data; RUN mkdir -p /data && chown -R node:node /app /data; EXPOSE 3000; VOLUME ["/data"]; explicit non-root USER node (UID 1000); exec-form CMD ["pnpm","start"] with no > or >> redirect) plus build/run/restart docs, and re-confirmed it byte-for-byte at backend/Dockerfile, server/Dockerfile, apps/server/Dockerfile. The task still cannot be completed as specified: the graded suites (test/container-contract.test.js, container-nonroot-contract.test.js, container-logs-contract.test.js, restart-persistence.test.js) resolve ROOT=/workspace and read /workspace/Dockerfile and /workspace/README.md, but this run's write policy rejects every repository-root deployment path. I verified this directly this run: write_file to /Dockerfile, /README.md, /.dockerignore, /docker/Dockerfile were each rejected with "Path is not writable: ... (allowed: apps/server/, server/, backend/, src/, and project manifests/configs at the repository root (package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, tsconfig*.json, .gitignore, ...))", while /backend/Dockerfile was accepted (rewritten with identical content, no net change). Container contract run: 24 tests, 10 passed, 14 failed, 0 errors — all 14 failures are exactly the missing /workspace/Dockerfile (AC-24 x4, AC-25 x2, AC-26 x5, AC-29 x3); every behavioural case (health reachability, DATA_DIR confinement, restart persistence, stdout-only logging, secret-leak guards) passes, so there is no functional regression. Unblocking requires a plan/scope change (grant repo-root write scope for Dockerfile + README.md, or map backend/ to the repository root during assembly); the already-delivered backend/Dockerfile is byte-compatible with all four static audits.
